description: D26 disguise/joy-pass property (worlds/bramble/heartbeat_crossing.gd, whisper_spot.gd, seed_puff_toy.gd). --pads=2. Seat 1 (Pip) teleports onto AscentLedge3/ASCENT_L3 (42,20,30) at frame 10 and holds through frame 250 (~4s) -- expect repeated HEARTBEAT receipts (rate-limited every 2s while occupied). At frame 260 Pip teleports into the WhisperSpot alcove near ASCENT_SUMMIT (41,33,11) -- expect WHISPER {"event":"hush"} once, plus a MOON_SAID receipt for the whisper_shh key (falls back to printing the raw key as text -- data/moon_lines.json is out of this pass's territory, see whisper_spot.gd's own header). At frame 320 Pip teleports away (clear of the 3m alcove radius) -- expect WHISPER {"event":"restore"}. Seat 2 (Otto) teleports near SeedPuffToyBase (15.0,0.45,19.0 -- fixed live: the original (20,0.45,20) sat ON Ramp1's sloped surface, ~2.8m from its centerline and well inside the 4.5m half-width, and a pound there slid Otto ~40m off course instead of landing in place; (15,19) has a NEGATIVE dot product against the ramp's own travel direction -- behind its start edge, flat pre-climb meadow) at frame 340, then performs the SAME proven jump-then-airborne-interact pound sequence as tools/harness/scripts/pound_bounce.json (jump press/release, interact press/release ~20/26 ticks later while still airborne) -- expect SEED_PUFF {"event":"burst"} once POUND_LAND fires and the toy's BURST_RADIUS (3.5m) check passes.
